cells.value: Make Sure the Valve is in Good Condition
Leaking valves should be examined during repair to assess the valve condition. If the valve is obviously in poor condition, it should be reconditioned or replaced.
Handle valves with care: avoid lifting valves by their handwheel or stem, cradle valves when transporting, do not use cheater bars, and clean an exposed valve stem before operating the valve.

Use Chevron alliance suppliers to reduce the total cost of ownership for valves. The alliance supplier for valve reconditioning is Plant Specialties Inc. An alliance also exists with McJunkin, a valve distributor. Several valve manufacturers have been recommended for alliances (see “Valve Manufacturer & Reconditioner Alliances” on page 1400-22).

When using other suppliers, check that manufacturer’s or reconditioner’s valve specifications are similar to the Petroleum Environmental Research Forum (PERF) [2] study recommendations and meet API or ANSI standards for valve design.
